generation_parents.algorithm: Combine a scale-free linear radial pull with an elongation ratio and a capacity-adaptive early-return threshold to pick the next customer while greedily filling the vehicle before returning to the depot.

Compute a scale-free composite score combining normalized radial pull (d_cur - alpha*d_dep)/scale with elongation ratio rho = d_cur/(d0i+d0j), a mild capacity-fill reward, and a capacity-adaptive early-return gate so near-full trucks return to depot instead of bridging.
